name: 57747 · Hot Springs, SD
findings: ZIP 57747 (Hot Springs) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 57747 (Hot Springs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 57747 (Hot Springs) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
